answer: A remote attestation quotes the enclave code before the identity is allowed to act, and the chain groups identities by quoted measurement, so a farm running one image in one fleet collapses into a single counted voter. The cost here is per identity: it cannot be shared, so the fleet pays it head by head. The crystal is the quoted measurement, the fable the group it forms, and the terrace the voice that group is worth; the crystal and the fable collapse a farm, while only a fresh terrace of hardware escapes the grouping.
